events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 07 (today)): Wingard added Darius Cooper (WR, PHI) for $11 FAAB.
TRADE (Oct 07 (today)): Charles receives Chris Olave (WR, NO), 2027 R2 pick. Wingard receives 2028 R1 pick, 2027 R2 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 06 (yesterday)): Fronge added Tyler Huntley (QB, BAL) for $21 FAAB (dropped Skyy Moore (WR, GB)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 05 (2 days ago)): Drew added Joe Mixon (RB, FA) for $19 FAAB (dropped DJ Herman (RB, MIA)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (3 days ago)): Brent added Brycen Tremayne (WR, CAR).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (3 days ago)): Mitchum added Jacob Cowing (WR, SF).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (3 days ago)): Drew added Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL) (dropped Emari Demercado (RB, DAL)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (4 days ago)): Ryan added Devontez Walker (WR, BAL).

WEEK 4 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Brent, 139.7-131.1; Jake def. Adam, 122.9-109.6; Wingard def. Drew, 104.0-93.1; Shaq def. Fronge, 138.3-119.6; Charles def. Ryan, 162.2-138.9; Mitchum def. Kevin, 187.8-133.8 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Charles acquires Chris Olave and a 2027 second from Wingard in exchange for a 2028 first and a 2027 second. Crownline adds a wide receiver. The 8-0 team is shopping. SDR gets future capital. Full details on the transaction desk now.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: To add context to Marty's flash: Wingard was sitting at $65.03 and 3-5 before this deal. Trading Olave and a 2027 second to the undefeated team for a 2028 first is either genius long-term capital management or the most expensive white flag in SDR history. I report it. You decide.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 8-0, just beat Ryan by 23 points, and is now acquiring weapons mid-season from a 3-5 team. Crownline at $136.79 is the market-cap leader and the gap between that number and second place is starting to feel structural. The Ledger will have the full Wingard-Charles transaction breakdown and I want everyone ready for what that cost-benefit column looks like.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I want a segment — not a sidebar, a full segment — where someone explains what Wingard is building. SDR hoards picks, sits at 3-5, adds Darius Cooper off waivers for $11 FAAB today, and then ships Olave to the 8-0 team. Is that a rebuild? A pivot? A surrender with paperwork?

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge is in Havana, 2-6, just dropped Skyy Moore to add Tyler Huntley for $21 FAAB, and somehow has a Week 5 matchup against the 0-8 team that I still cannot figure out how to feel about. One of those franchises walks away with a win on Sunday and neither outcome fixes anything structural.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Corbishley-Jake matchup as the most interesting game on the slate two days ago and nothing that happened between then and now has changed my mind. APEX at $123.00, ECHO at $104.02, both rising, one takes damage Sunday. Get your position before the bell.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: On record before Week 5: I am taking Charles over Mitchum, Corbishley over Jake, and Kevin over Brent. Yes I am 5-7. Yes those are three favorites. I have made peace with where I am on the board and I am not going to manufacture a contrarian take to rehabilitate the record. The scoreboard will do what it does.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Terrence taking the chalk three straight is a legitimate strategy after 5-7. It is also exactly what someone does when they stop trusting their own process. I am 7-5, my locks are 2-0, and I am still willing to take Mitchum in the Charles game because 187 points last week is not a fluke you just paper over with an undefeated record.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew added Joe Mixon two days ago, added Tyler Goodson four days before that, and is 0-8 with $395.5 points scored on the season. ATLAS is at $49.72. I respect the waiver activity. I do not respect what any of it means in the context of a franchise where liquidation-risk gets brought up in serious conversations.
